summary: Ubuntu 16.10 (Yakkety Yak) was released on 13 October 2016. Features: Unity 8 preview available (not default), improved snap integration, Mesa 12, Python 3.6. The yak symbolized endurance and conversation (yakkety = talkative). Last interim before the switch to GNOME.
notes: Unsupported since 2017-07-20. Kernel 4.8. Unity 8 was still in development; GNOME switch announced for 17.10.
